findings.title: end_call dispatched before the recorded closing condition
findings.summary: The agent dispatched end_call before the recorded closing condition was satisfied. The recorded policy requires both sides to say goodbye; the available transcript did not establish that exchange before dispatch. Dispatch does not prove immediate audible disconnection.

evidence.label: Recorded end_call closing condition
evidence.value: After you have both said goodbye, use the end_call tool to hang up.

evidence.label: Pre-dispatch agent transcript (commit time)
evidence.value: No, that’s everything for now. Thanks a lot for your help, Taylor.

evidence.label: Pre-dispatch user transcript (commit time)
evidence.value: Okay. Have a great day. Goodbye.

root_cause.statement: The agent may have inferred that the conversation was complete and triggered the call-ending tool too early.
missing_evidence: The model/tool-selection trace explaining the dispatch
Audio or playout confirmation of when farewells and disconnection occurred

next_steps: Review the recorded closing instruction and tool availability at dispatch.
Gate end_call on an explicit completed closing state, then repeat the scenario.
Compare dispatch, terminal status, transcript commitment and audio/playout timing separately.
